entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ReusableUtf8JsonWriter holds on the `IBufferWriter<byte>` after `Return` #62263
  • Quarantine Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel.Transport.NamedPipes.Tests -> OutOfMemory #62262
  • [Blazor] Register/Login forms no longer work in Blazor Web App template #62260
  • Angular and ASP.NET Core Template fails on creation #62258
  • Consider making `TokenExtensions.UpdateTokenValue()`'s `tokenValue` parameter nullable #62257
  • Upgrade xunit to v3 #62256
  • Proposal: Add an HTTP-based JS to .NET interop option to unblock large‑payload scenarios in Blazor Server #62255
  • Blazor activity traces get hidden by the SignalR activities for the Blazor component hub #62254
    10.0-preview7

Closed

  • error MSB4018: The "DiscoverPrecompressedAssets" task failed unexpectedly. An item with the same key has already been added #62251
  • E2E tests are not running #62223
    10.0-preview6
  • WebApplicationFactory.Services throws Exception with new UseKestrel API #62224
  • Allow to inherit rendertree markup in blazor components #62233
  • multipart/form-data request forces form read (request body read) before endpoint handler code #62117

PullRequests

Created

  • # Area-owners.md: Update doc owners for each area #62261
    Docs
  • [Blazor] Adds support for persisting and restoring disconnected circuits from storage #62259
    area-blazor
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #62253
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:

Merged

  • Upgrade Ubuntu and Azure Linux VMs and Containers #61853
    area-infrastructure, 10.0-preview6
  • [MVC.Testing] Fix NullReferenceException #62231
    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-mvc-testing, 10.0-preview6
  • Don't change Arcade's default of XUnitRunnerVisualStudioVersion #62250
    area-infrastructure, 10.0-preview6

Updated

  • Add passkeys to ASP.NET Core Identity #62112
    area-identity
  • feat(HTTP.SYS): on-demand TLS client hello retrieval #62209
    feature-httpsys, area-networking
  • Respect JsonSerializerOptions casing for property names in validation errors #62036
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Add IMemoryPoolFactory and cleanup memory pool while idle #61554
    feature-iis, feature-kestrel, feature-httpsys, area-networking
  • Move unified validation APIs to separate package #62071
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Feature for setting activity tags on creation #62090
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-networking
  • Update Microsoft.OpenApi dependencies to 2.0.0-preview.21 #62126
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • [Blazor] Compute relative root in preloading paths #62225
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview6
  • Change priority of re-execution handling and allow router to stream `NotFound` contents #62178
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview6
  • Read E2E logs and fail the job if no tests matched the filter #62222
    area-infrastructure
  • [OpenAPI] Use invariant culture for TextWriter #62193
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • [release/9.0] Fixed devtools url used for debug with chrome and edge #61948
    Servicing-consider, 9.0.x
